name: My Melody
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independently AI-generated flat-cartoon V2 fan interpretation with nine task animations and sixteen clockwise look directions, prepared for community request #320.
description: An unofficial, independently AI-generated My Melody fan companion. A compact white bunny companion in a simple pink hood. zhou-jianwen is credited only as the independent AI-assisted adapter, not the character creator or reference artist.
source_notes: The official Sanrio character page (https://sanrio.com.cn/family_details3.html) and its gallery image (https://sanrio.com.cn/images/family/3/kv1.jpg) were used only as appearance references. The pet independently interprets a simple classic pink hood rather than reproducing the gallery party dresses, hats, frills, fabric, text or background. No reference pixels are committed. Sprite pixels were independently generated with the built-in image_gen tool, followed by native-alpha extraction, intact whole-pose retiling for spacing and deterministic V2 assembly. Both locomotion directions were generated independently to preserve the flower and folded-ear laterality. This package fulfills the specific My Melody request #320; it does not establish completion of the remaining characters in mixed request #311.
